homeEyebrow: A clearer view of your prescription
homeDescription: We transcribe what we can read and make uncertainty visible.
photoInstructions: Take a clear, well-lit photo of the prescription.
offlineNote: Analysis needs an internet connection at some point. Offline photos are saved on this phone.
disclaimer: Prototype, not clinically validated. This is a transcription aid, not medical advice.
referenceInfoFooter: Reference information from a drug label. Not medical advice. Ask a pharmacist.
photoRetention: Deleted from our server right after analysis. On your phone, it stays only while you review it.
photoAlt: Your prescription photo — tap to enlarge
sampleBanner: Sample result — precomputed from a clearly labelled fictional test image. Viewing this sample does not call the API.
notPrescription: The model classified this synthetic image as not a prescription. This sample demonstrates rejection only, not medicine reading.
mockBanner: Simulation result — this is not a reading of your photo.
queuedDetail: It will be analyzed when the service is available.
retryDetail: Your photo is saved on this phone and will be sent when online.
offlineProgress: Offline — photo saved on this phone.
offlineDetail: It will be sent automatically when the connection returns.
errorImage: This image could not be read. Please choose another photo.
errorActiveJob: A prescription is already in progress. Wait for its result before sending another.
errorLocalStorage: This phone could not save the photo. Check available storage and try again.
errorDeletePending: The request failed, but its local photo could not be deleted. Clear this site's data in your browser settings.
errorDeleteResult: The result arrived, but its local photo could not be deleted. Clear this site's data in your browser settings.
errorRelayId: The relay response did not include a job ID.
errorExpired: This result has expired. Please send the prescription again.
errorAnalysis: Analysis did not complete. Please show the prescription to a pharmacist.
errorNoSample: The synthetic sample or its precomputed result is unavailable.
errorUnexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errorLocalDelete: The pending photo could not be deleted from this phone.
errorLocalRead: The saved photo could not be loaded. Keep this page open and try again.
resultDisplayFailure: Could not display the result. Show the paper prescription to a pharmacist.
notVerifiedSummary: No source entry was found for {count} medicine pair(s).
aiSuggestedDisclaimer: Generated by an AI model from general knowledge. Not checked against a source. Ask a pharmacist.
aiLanguageNote: Shown in English or French only
printNoDocumented: No drug-label information was found for this pair. This is not a safety assessment.
printUnreviewed: Not yet reviewed by a pharmacist (unreviewed).
unreviewedNote: Source: {source} ({date}). Not yet reviewed by a pharmacist.
noPairs: There are no medicine pairs to check.
uncertainEmpty: No uncertain medicine names were returned.
uncertainImage: The image quality is {quality}. Some text may not be readable.
detectedTitle: Transcribed with confidence — the original remains the reference
detectedEmpty: No medicine name met the confidence threshold.
fonUnavailable: Fon translation is unavailable. The documented English and French summaries are shown.
accessPrompt: Enter the demo access code to submit an analysis.
accessInvalid: The access code is missing or incorrect.
dailyLimitReached: The daily analysis limit has been reached. Please try again tomorrow.
dailyLimitUnavailable: The daily limit could not be checked, so this analysis was not run.
rateLimitWait: Too many requests. Your photo is still saved here; retrying in {seconds} seconds.
noInteractionSafety: The lookup reports only pairs listed in the cited table.
unverifiedMedicines: Names below the confidence threshold are excluded from the reference lookup.
